after_snippet:
import asyncio
from aiohttp import ClientSession, encode_basic_auth

async def test():
    # In 3.14.0, use encode_basic_auth() with Authorization header
    async with ClientSession() as session:
        # encode_basic_auth defaults to utf-8 (not latin1)
        auth_header = encode_basic_auth('user', 'pass')
        async with session.get(
            'http://httpbin.org/basic-auth/user/pass',
            headers={'Authorization': auth_header}
        ) as resp:
            assert resp.status == 200

asyncio.run(test())

import asyncio
from aiohttp import ClientSession, BasicAuth

async def test():
    # In 3.13.5, BasicAuth was the standard way
    async with ClientSession() as session:
        async with session.get(
            'http://httpbin.org/basic-auth/user/pass',
            auth=BasicAuth('user', 'pass')
        ) as resp:
            assert resp.status == 200

asyncio.run(test())
